events.verdict: Drummond (DET) jumps and slightly turns his body, but the contact to Mitchell (UTA) does not affect his ability to pass.
[Observable in enhanced video] Griffin (DET) is in the lane without actively guarding an opponent and fails to clear in under three seconds.
Crowder (UTA) and Griffin (DET) briefly engage and separate off ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Griffin (DET) moves his foot heel-to-toe to create space before dribbling.
[Observable in enhanced video] Gobert (UTA) is in the lane without actively guarding an opponent and clears the lane twice in the sequence.
Crowder (UTA) legally contests Griffin's (DET) jump shot attempt and LLB shows that he does not make contact to Griffin's arm during his shooting motion.
Drummond (DET) and Gobert (UTA) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Gobert (UTA) sets the screen on Thomas (DET) and does not deliver contact.
Thomas (DET) makes contact to Ingles (UTA) on the drive that affects his SQBR.
Griffin (DET) steps out of bounds.
Gobert (UTA) sets the screen on Thomas (DET) and does not deliver contact.
Drummond (DET) moves laterally into Mitchell (UTA) and makes contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Ingles (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position in Griffin's (DET) path and absorbs but does not deliver the contact during the inbounds.
Drummond (DET) sets the screen on O'Neale (UTA) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Gobert (UTA) makes marginal contact with Drummond's (DET) body during his driving shot attempt.
Mitchell (UTA) comes across Drummond's (DET) arm after making contact with the ball. The contact to Drummond's arm affects his shot attempt.
Griffin (DET) briefly gets his arm across Crowder (UTA), but slides it off and does not affect his FOM.
Thomas (DET) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Mitchell (UTA).
[Observable in enhanced video] Bullock (DET) takes more than two steps after gathering his dribble.
Griffin (DET) sets the screen in Ingles's (UTA) path and does not deliver contact.
Ingles (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position during Griffin's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Thomas (DET) commits a take foul on Korver (UTA).
